about: Parity vectors for app/static/js/engine/settings.js, generated from app/settings_registry.py and app/settings_store.py by tests/data/gen_settings_vectors.py. Do not edit by hand: change the registry, then regenerate.

registry.label: AI ideas
registry.help: opt_in, provider (auto, own or shared:<id>), share_age_sex and preferences (at most 200 characters).

registry.label: People may enter their own AI server address
registry.help: Only https on port 443 to public addresses. Off by default; always off when AI_HTTP_PROXY is set.

registry.label: Keep what was sent to and received from AI for (days)
registry.help: Each person sees their own AI activity in Settings. 0 keeps only the time, provider and outcome. Backups keep it until they expire.

registry.label: Optional AI ideas
registry.help: Off by default. When on, people who opt in can ask an AI provider you set up for meal ideas and photo help. The rules always run first and check every AI idea; nothing is sent anywhere while this is off.

registry.label: AI calls at the same time (whole server)
registry.help: Each person has at most one call running. Extra calls are told to try again in a few seconds.

registry.label: Shared AI calls per person per day
registry.help: Counts meal ideas, described meals, photos and connection tests on shared providers. 0 means unlimited.

registry.label: People may use their own AI key
registry.help: For OpenAI, OpenRouter or Nous Portal. Their key is encrypted and never shown again.

registry.label: Allow photos to go to a Hermes agent
registry.help: Off by default. Text printed on a package could try to instruct an agent; even when on, the app only uses a Hermes profile whose tool check passes.

registry.label: Plate photos (AI estimate of what is on a plate)
registry.help: Off by default. Needs a provider with a vision model. Portion estimates from photos are rough: the app says so on every result and never logs them without a tap.

registry.label: Keep the activity log for (days)
Remember barcodes that were not found for (hours)
registry.help: A barcode that Open Food Facts or USDA did not know is not asked again for this long.

registry.label: Send barcodes I scan to Open Food Facts
registry.help: Your own choice, used only when the admin has turned Open Food Facts lookups on.

registry.label: Contact sent to Open Food Facts
registry.help: Goes into the User-Agent of every lookup, as Open Food Facts asks of API users. An admin email address is better than the default project address. Letters, digits and punctuation only (no round brackets or backslash).

registry.label: Look up barcodes with Open Food Facts
registry.help: Off by default. When on, a barcode that is not in this server's food list is looked up at world.openfoodfacts.org (only the barcode number is sent). Product data is under the Open Database License.

registry.label: Open Food Facts lookups per minute (whole server)
registry.help: Open Food Facts allows 15 product lookups a minute from one address and may block an address that sends more. Everyone on this server shares this budget; products already looked up do not count.

registry.label: Also look barcodes up in USDA FoodData Central
registry.help: Uses the person's USDA key or the shared one, when Open Food Facts does not know a product, has no nutrition facts for it, or lacks potassium or sodium for a US product.

registry.label: Meal guidance preferences
registry.help: carb_tolerance_g (5–20) and hypo_dose_g (5–30) come from your diabetes team.

registry.label: Plan builder: search width
registry.help: Partial meals kept at each step. 8 is about 15 % faster and finds slightly worse meals.

registry.label: Meal guidance
registry.help: Rule-based suggestions for the next meal, swap ideas, plan-the-day and insights. Works without AI.

registry.label: Plan builder: foods considered per role
registry.help: Lower it (for example to 120) if planning a day is slow on a small server such as a Raspberry Pi 4.

registry.label: Server name
registry.help: Shown on the sign-in page and in the app's title.

registry.label: Shared USDA lookups per person per day
registry.help: 0 means unlimited.

registry.label: Share the server's USDA key
registry.help: Effective only when a shared key is set.

registry.label: People may add their own USDA key
Invite links expire after (days)
Registration
registry.help: invite: admins send single-use links. closed: admins create accounts. open: anyone who reaches the page can register (HTTPS required).

registry.label: Activity level used until a person chooses theirs
registry.help: Used for the calorie estimate (2023 Dietary Reference Intakes).

registry.label: An albumin result counts for (days)
A bicarbonate result counts for (days)
A phosphate result counts for (days)
A potassium result counts for (days)
Let lab results change suggested targets
registry.help: Off: potassium and phosphorus suggestions use the stage defaults and lab notes are left out. The warning for a very high potassium result is always shown. Keep it off on public demo servers until a clinician has reviewed the lab rules.

registry.label: Theme
Units for lab results
registry.help: us: mg/dL (creatinine, phosphate), g/dL (albumin), mg/g (urine albumin), % (HbA1c). si: µmol/L, mmol/L, g/L, mg/mmol, mmol/mol. Only the unit offered first changes; any unit can still be entered.
